build: pnpm build:client && pnpm dev:cargo -- build --workspace --examples --features lapis-agent/test-support --locked
check: pnpm check:governance && pnpm format:check && pnpm check:boundaries && pnpm check:client && pnpm check:clippy
check:governance: pnpm check:validation-routing && pnpm spec:validate && pnpm release:check && pnpm check:architecture && pnpm check:progress && pnpm check:upstream
test: pnpm test:client && pnpm test:governance && pnpm dev:cargo -- test --workspace --features lapis-agent/test-support --locked
package:check: pnpm build:client && node scripts/client-package.mjs && node scripts/package-check.mjs
release:dry-run: pnpm package:check && pnpm dev:cargo -- publish --workspace --exclude lapis-compute --locked --dry-run
validation:all: pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm check:workflow && pnpm package:check && pnpm spec:check
